column1: # Scene|Route|Expected visible state and workflow description|Boundary

e2e-home-notes|Launch > Home > Notes|Home shows the saved Workflow note and Notes/Doc tabs. Library, voice capture, search and Filters remain reachable. This is the starting page of the Library traversal.|The synthetic note is not a copy of personal content.

e2e-home-doc|Home > Doc tab|Switch to the Doc workspace after returning from every Library destination; capture the empty Doc state without converting the existing Notes item.|Tab switching is distinct from importing or converting a note.

e2e-page-archive|Home > Library > Archive|Open Archive, capture its empty state and visible Back, then return to the Home search field. Archived content is separate from Trash.|This route does not archive or restore a note; mutation/retention tests appear in the method ledger.

e2e-page-trash|Home > Library > Trash|Open Trash, capture its empty state and Back, then return Home. The workflow performs no permanent deletion.|Retention, restore and purge are separate native tests, not established by the empty page.

e2e-page-folders|Home > Library > Folders|Open Folders with synthetic app-private storage, capture the available location/create controls and return Home.|Actual DocumentsProvider folder grants, copying and recovery are separate RealFolderStorageTest methods.

e2e-page-voice-inbox|Home > Library > Voice inbox|Open the inbox, capture its empty-recordings state and return Home. This checks navigation without asking for microphone permission.|Playback with actual saved audio is tested separately; this empty screen proves neither audibility nor recognition accuracy.

e2e-page-viewed-files|Home > Library > Viewed files|Show the searchable history page and zero-file count. Open its options/help, close them and return Home without creating a note.|The first traversal uses an empty history; search/count matching is exercised by a separate seeded-index workflow.

e2e-viewed-options|Viewed files > three-dot options|Show history help and the explicit history/index-clear action in a compact overflow rather than permanently occupying the reader.|No history is cleared in this traversal; confirmation/data safety are separate operations.

e2e-viewed-help|Viewed files options > About viewed files and search|Show the bounded32-file /2Mi-character index explanation, partial-index limitation and distinction from saved Notes/Docs and file backups; close the dialog.|Read-only history is not an authoritative file backup.

e2e-settings-library|Home > Library|Open Library before the Settings traversal. The sheet provides secondary destinations without duplicate Notes/Doc workspace entries.|The screenshot is the menu state, not proof of each destination's behaviour.

e2e-settings|Library > Settings|Show Appearance, Speech engine, Home widget, Storage & recovery, Diagnostics and About/model destinations. Continue through the tested child pages and use Back to the actual caller.|Home widget request/launcher consent is covered separately; this traversal does not add a physical widget.

e2e-appearance|Settings > Appearance|Show System/Light/Dark choices, then Cancel without changing persisted appearance. Other profile runs independently configure night and font scale.|Cancelling a chooser is not a physical acceptance of every theme/contrast combination.

e2e-speech-engine|Settings > Speech engine|Show Standard Vosk and experimental trained Whisper choices and cancel. Preserve the existing engine and original recordings.|This does not train a model or establish physical Indian-accent accuracy.

e2e-diagnostics|Settings > Diagnostics|Show opt-in collection, local log size, View & filter logs, explicitly named Save diagnostic log as a file and confirmed-delete controls.|The new label makes an existing Android create-document operation discoverable. This capture is not proof that a real destination file was written.

e2e-diagnostic-log-viewer|Diagnostics > View & filter logs|Open parsed on-device records with Time range, Levels, Refresh, record count and Save filtered logs. This traversal uses synthetic/empty diagnostic state.|No personal diagnostic attachment is loaded or displayed. Filter/export internals are separate tests.

e2e-log-time-range|Diagnostic logs > Time range|Display retained-time presets and custom local time range; cancel without changing the active filter.|Custom parsing and inclusive range semantics have separate native assertions.
e2e-log-levels|Diagnostic logs > Levels|Display DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR multi-choice filters; cancel without deleting or changing logs.|Level filtering is not consent to enable collection.

e2e-log-delete-confirmation|Diagnostics > Delete diagnostic logs|Show the permanent local-log deletion explanation and Cancel. It explicitly distinguishes exported files and older App-folder copies from local logs.|The destructive action is not executed in this traversal.

e2e-about-models|Settings > About & offline models|Show local version, offline feature/model information and licence/disclosure content; return to Settings.|A displayed model licence/version is not recognition-quality certification.

e2e-storage|Settings > Storage & recovery|Show private-first storage/recovery controls and current synthetic storage status; open More options & repair and later return through Settings to Home.|No private user folder is selected and no migration of personal data occurs.

e2e-storage-repair|Storage & recovery > More options & repair|Open the additional repair/copy controls rather than presenting them as a routine save-success flow. Continue to App-folder copy choices.|Viewing a repair menu does not resolve the user's actual pending-folder difference.

e2e-storage-copy-choices|Storage repair > App-folder copy choices|Show selectable additional copies of voice, settings, history and opt-in diagnostics; cancel without changing preferences or collection consent.|A copy-category selection is not permission to collect diagnostics or proof that a folder checkpoint completed.

library|Home > Library|Open secondary destinations: Archive, Trash, Folders, Voice inbox, Settings, Open file and Viewed files. Notes and Doc remain Home workspace tabs rather than duplicate Library rows.|This is a fresh current candidate capture, not the historical code41 menu used in the earlier handbook.

filters-sort|Home > Filters > Sort|Display edited/created/title sorting and arranged as per user. Apply persists the chosen view; native long-hold drag also injects a late board refresh while the gesture is active and verifies saved presentation order.|Persisted sort assertions are separate from physical top-edge placement and perceived smoothness.

diagram-options|Diagram > Diagram options|Show grouping and arrow-editing commands. The candidate retains split-connector junctions and scoped shape/group operations in the diagram model.|A menu screenshot is not a claim of arbitrary diagram equivalence or physical gesture acceptance.

diagram-group|Diagram > grouped shapes|Inspect the grouped diagram fixture. Model/view tests separately check group movement, independent duplication and deletion boundaries.|Source content and Undo assertions, not the screenshot alone, establish preservation.

voice-inbox|Library > Voice inbox|Display saved synthetic recordings with play/pause, seek position and elapsed/total duration; Recording options exposes export, retry and open-note controls. The current candidate also makes the card itself toggle playback and shows Preparing playback while loading.|No physical microphone quality, noise-removal, loudness or Indian-accent improvement is implied. Synthetic WAV playback is not a phone listening test.

folders|Library > Folders|Show private-first folder navigation and available folder creation/storage controls without waiting for optional provider discovery. Actual SAF grant/copy/recovery operations have separate native methods.|This fresh screenshot does not establish acceptance of the user's real connected folder or pending difference.

diagnostics|Settings > Diagnostics|Show opt-in collection, bounded local-log status, View & filter logs, Save diagnostic log as a file and confirmed deletion. Saving is user initiated and never uploads automatically.|These are synthetic CI records. The supplied personal export is not part of this screen or report.

ocr-review|Read image > review|Show editable OCR review and insertion/save choices. This UI fixture can use prepared text/regions to exercise controls; actual bundled-engine recognition is separately identified in OfflineOcrTest.|This screenshot is not a measurement of the user's image accuracy. False-script recognition and missed text remain open physical issues.

ocr-review-empty|Read image > empty review|Show the empty/review state with insertion disabled until nonblank text exists; cancellation preserves the source.|Prepared UI fixtures and actual recognition results are distinct. Empty-state handling does not prove recognition completeness.

word-zoom|Notes/Doc > embedded image or drawing > zoom|Exercise the embedded image/drawing preview zoom limits and preserve original image pixels and drawing kind. The historical scene identifier says word-zoom, but the owning test is an embedded-visual test, not an imported Word/PDF reader test.|This frame must not be presented as proof of imported Word or PDF viewer fidelity. Real signed-reader captures are reported separately.

content-item-drag|Doc > checklist row handle > native drag|Capture the native checklist-item drag before release. The owning workflow verifies rich row content, checked/depth state, exact saved order, Undo and the non-drag accessibility move alternative.|This is a checklist-row gesture, not Home card arrangement or a whole-document block move.

image-text-selection|Read image review > Select from image|Show image-coordinate word selection with prepared synthetic word boxes. The workflow checks that changing selection changes only review text until explicit append, retaining the note and image pixels.|The prepared boxes exercise selection UI; they are not real-image recognition accuracy evidence.
